that\u0022],\u0022Type\u0022:\u0022Bugfix\u0022,\u0022AgentContext\u0022:\u0022Second card of issue #788 (Jeff\\u0027s report), walked with Brian 2026-10-30; the first card is 679b569e and neither depends on the other. The allow list is ClaudeSettingsFile.PrReviewAllowedTools (ClaudeSettingsFile.cs:515); it came from the security review\\u0027s process-injection finding 1 and Brian\\u0027s 2026-09-27 ruling that no pr-review session runs with permissions skipped. Its own comment says it grows by evidence, and #788 is that evidence. These sessions read untrusted pull request text, so the danger is a hijacked session reading a secret outside the checkout or writing anything. The guard (GitReadOnlyGuardRoutes) already refuses --output and --no-index on git diff and git log, because prefix rules cannot. Flags to check, unverified: git blame --contents, git grep --no-index, -O and -f, git show --output, --ext-diff and --textconv.
